Hon'ble Dinesh Pathak,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Instant writ petition has been filed, inter alia, for the following relief :-
"issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent no.2 the Settlement Officer Consolidation, Mau, District: Mau to ensure the hearing of the Appeal No.1595/1839 Case No.0619/2023 Computerized Cases No.
20234155100000619 Manoj and others Vs. Tribhuvan and others filed u/s 11 (1)
U.P.C.H. Act 1953 and decide the same within stipulated time which this Hon'ble Court may fixed."
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that having been aggrieved with the order dated 29.08.2023 passed in proceeding under Section 9-A(2) of U.P.C.H. Act, present petitioner along with other persons have preferred appeal under Section 11(1) of the U.P.C.H. Act which is Manoj Kumar vs State Of Up And 26 Others on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41930877/
1

entities.text:
Computerized Cases No.
20234155100000619 Manoj and others Vs. Tribhuvan and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Manoj Kumar vs State Of Up And 26 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: pending consideration since 11.09.2023, despite the fact that opposite parties in the appeal have already appeared and the case is ready for final adjudication.

It is further submitted that the instant matter is urgent in view of the fact that land in question has been acquired under the land acquisition proceeding and there is a severe dispute qua compensation thereof.

4. Learned Standing Counsel has no objection, if a direction is issued to decide the aforesaid appeal,
expeditiously.
5. In this conspectus as above, no useful purpose would be served to keep this matter pending.

Therefore, this court deems it appropriate to finally dispose of the present writ petition, without making any observation on the merits of the case, as mentioned in the writ petition, with a direction to Respondent no.2 to decide the aforesaid appeal strictly in accordance with law, by means of a reasoned and speaking order, after affording opportunity of hearing to the parties concerned and without granting any unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties expeditiously, preferably,
within a period of ten months from the date of production of certified copy of this order.
6. With the aforesaid direction, this petition is finally disposed of.
Order Date :- 9.8.2024/ VR  Manoj Kumar vs State Of Up And 26 Others on 9 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41930877/
2
